translations.text: The Inevitable Reality -
What is the Inevitable Reality?
And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa ammaa 'Aadun fa uhlikoo bireehin sarsarin 'aatiyah

translations.text: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

verses.text_uthmani: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Sakhkharahaa 'alaihim sab'a la yaalinw wa samaaniyata ayyaamin husooman fataral qawma feehaa sar'aa ka annahum a'jaazu nakhlin khaawiyah

translations.text: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
Then do you see of them any remains?

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verses.transliteration: Wa jaaa'a Firawnu wa man qablahoo wal mu'tafikaatu bilhaati'ah

translations.text: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.

verses.text_uthmani: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً
verses.transliteration: Fa'ansaw Rasoola Rabbihim fa akhazahum akhzatar raabiyah

translations.text: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verses.transliteration: Innaa lammaa taghal maaa'u hamalnaakum fil jaariyah

translations.text: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

verses.text_uthmani: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Linaj'alahaa lakum tazki ratanw-wa ta'iyahaa unzununw waa'iyah

translations.text: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Fa izaa nufikha fis soori nafkhatunw waahidah

translations.text: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

verses.text_uthmani: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ
verses.transliteration: Wa humilatil ardu wal jibaalu fadukkataa dakkatanw waahidah

translations.text: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wal malaku 'alaaa arjaaa'ihaa; wa yahmilu 'Arsha Rabbika fawqahum yawma'izin samaaniyah

translations.text: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Yawma'izin tu'radoona laa takhfaa min kum khaafiyah

translations.text: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verses.transliteration: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fa yaqoolu haaa'umuq ra'oo kitaabiyah

translations.text: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
So he will be in a pleasant life -
In an elevated garden,
Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

verses.text_uthmani: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verses.transliteration: Kuloo washraboo haneee'am bimaaa aslaftum fil ayyaamil khaliyah

translations.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
verses.transliteration: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo bishimaalihee fa yaqoolu yaalaitanee lam oota kitaaabiyah

translations.text: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
And had not known what is my account.
I wish my death had been the decisive one.
My wealth has not availed me.
Gone from me is my authority."
[Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
Then into Hellfire drive him.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verses.transliteration: Summa fee silsilatin zar'uhaa sab'oona ziraa'an faslukooh

translations.text: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

translations.text: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

verses.transliteration: Wa laa ta'aamun illaa min ghisleen

translations.text: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
None will eat it except the sinners.
So I swear by what you see
And what you do not see
[That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa ma huwa biqawli shaa'ir; qaleelam maa tu'minoon

translations.text: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laa biqawli kaahin; qaleelam maa tazakkaroon

translations.text: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
[It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
We would have seized him by the right hand;
Then We would have cut from him the aorta.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ

translations.text: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.

verses.transliteration: Wa inna lana'lamu anna minkum mukazzibeen

translations.text: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
